title: The Wood of Unfinished Roads
intro: Once upon a time, two friends set out down a road that would not end. Their old cart groaned, the lanterns of a great stone library flickered behind them, and the trees leaned close to listen. For the wood remembers everything you ever said to each other, and tonight, it has come to collect.

incantations.storm: the car is making the noise

encounters.name: The Rusted Iron Steed
lines: The Steed lowers its rusted head and paws the road!
Gears grind; it rears to swing high!
It coughs a bolt of hot exhaust your way!
Forty miles from anything, and still it charges.
encounters.artPrompt: A storybook watercolor of a rusted iron horse made from an old road-trip car, steam leaking from its joints, on a moonlit forest road, warm and whimsical

boss.name: The Night Librarian
lines: Shhh. The library is closing, little ones.
Overdue! Overdue! The shelves sweep low!
She hurls a volume heavy with unwritten essays!
Not one word written, and the clock strikes three.
boss.artPrompt: A towering storybook librarian made of bookshelves and candlelight, spectacles glowing, holding a giant hourglass at 3am, ink-and-watercolor fairy tale illustration
